translation:
The ministerial fire (相火) is vigorous and in addition damp-heat descends, so that there is erection of the yang and seminal emission, the six pulses wiry and slippery. Use a method of nourishing and clearing, assisted by bitter draining.

Fresh Shengdi, Lianxu, Chiling, Danpi, Miren, Chuan Bai, Guiban, Bixie, Zexie, Gancao.

The seminal gate is not secure, with pain and flaccidity of the lumbar spine, the six pulses fine and soft without strength. One should astringe the essence and warm and supplement.

Stir-fried Shudi, Huai Shanyao, Chuanduan, Bei Wuwei, Xianglian rou, Zhi Yuzhu, Jinyingzi (Rosa fruit, 金櫻子), Duzhong, Bai Fuling.

Pill formula: remove Jinying (Rosa fruit); add Dangshen, Gouji, Xianyu jiao (fish glue, 線魚膠), and Sharen (Amomum, 砂仁).

The qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) is depressed, with distension of the diaphragm and dim vision, the sovereign fire (君火) pressing internally, the yin essence leaking, the pulse not soft — one should use a method of joining the heart and kidney with bitter draining (and with excessive use of the mind and palpitations, treat it as liver fire; because of overuse of the mind, taking supplementing agents had no effect).

Chuan Huanglian, Hei Shanzhi, Zexie, Lianxu, Baizishuang, Fa Banxia, Chiling, Yujin, Juye.

Kan and Li (坎離) do not join, with fright and spontaneous sweating, and recently seminal emission; the essence, qi and spirit are all deficient, the pulse empty and without strength. One must use heavy doses and supplement frequently (the feet are flaccid and walking is difficult).

Zhi Qi 3 qian, Wuwei 4 fen, honey-fried, Fushen 2 qian, calcined Muli 5 qian, Chuan Bai 1 qian, Gonggan (dried longan, 貢干) 1 liang, Shudi 8 qian, Maidong 3 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Huai Shanyao 3 qian, Xianglian 7 grains.

Loss of blood together with seminal emission, deficiency and damage of the liver and kidney, the sinews contracted so that sitting and lying are restless, the six pulses fine and soft without strength — this belongs to lower deficiency and blood not nourishing the liver. And with leakage and spontaneous sweating, this is a condition of great deficiency; one must use heavy doses to cultivate and supplement.

Zhi Qi 2 qian, Bei Wuweizi 4 fen, Fushen 2 qian, Jin Gouji 1.5 qian, Gan Qizi 2 qian, Shudi 5 qian, Maidong rou 2 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, calcined Longchi 2 qian, Chuan Yujin 1 qian.

The heart and kidney do not join, with much dreaming and seminal emission, and in ordinary times there is blood in the stool. One should regulate with Hei Guipi (黑歸脾).

Zhi Yuzhu, Fushen, Jinyingzi, Maidong rou, Zexie, stir-fried Shengdi, Zaoren, Lianxu, Bei Wuwei.

Pill formula:

Xi Dangshen, Shudi, Fushen, Jinyingzi, Maidong, Guiban xin, Zhi Yuzhu, Xianglian, Zaoren, Wuwei rou, Muli, Chuan Bai. Make pills with honey.

Hemoptysis recurs, and recently there is seminal emission; fortunately the pulse is not rapid and there is no wheezing — one can see that the yin aspect is not greatly depleted; it is injury to the yin collaterals. First regulate, then supplement.

Bei Shashen, Chen Ejiao, Danshen, Lianxu, Huafen, Maidong rou, Chuan Baihe, Qiancao, Fushen.

Pill formula:

Xi Dang, Maidong, Fushen, Bai Xianjiao (white fish glue, 白線膠), Guiban, Bei Shashen, Shudi, Wuwei, Zaoren, calcined Muli, Xianglian, Danpi. Make pills with lotus root juice.

The yin aspect is insufficient, and in addition damp fire rushes upward, the crown of the head sinks, with seminal emission, pain and flaccidity of the governing vessel (督脈) — treat by clearing the upper and absorbing the lower.

Shudi, Guiban, Lianxu, Shijueming, Shouwu, Chuan Bai, Fuling, winter mulberry leaf.
translator_notes: 相火 (xiang huo) and 君火 (jun huo) rendered as 'ministerial fire' and 'sovereign fire' respectively.
坎離 (kan li) refers to the heart and kidney; rendered literally as 'Kan and Li'.

translation:
The middle qi is insufficient, with turbid discharge descending — treat by using Sijun (四君) to secure the essence.

Zhen Xidang, Fushen, Muli, Bei Wuwei, Zhi Cao, Huai Shanyao, Bixie, Niuxi, stir-fried Baishao.

Another pill formula: the previous formula with Yuzhu, Miren, and Xianglian rou added.

Prolonged turbid discharge with deficiency of the primordial, the six pulses without strength — strengthen the middle and raise the clear, and it will naturally be comfortable.

Zhi Yuzhu, Bixie, sheng Miren, Muli, Dongguazi, Chiling, Zexie, Sha Jili (Astragalus complanatus, 沙蒺藜), Shanyao, Gancao shao (licorice tip, 甘草梢).

The spleen and kidney are both deficient, with lumbar pain and turbid discharge; unavoidably one has used the mind too much, and the sovereign fire (君火) sinks; but this illness has long entangled the Mingmen (命門), the yang qi not restraining, so that the upper pulse is deep and weak and the stools are thin and loose. I propose a method of Buzhong Yiqi (補中益氣) combined with nourishing the kidney (previously took several liang of Dahuang (rhubarb) without effect).

Zhen Xidang, Shudi, Fushen, Rougui, Zhi Cao, Zhi Yuzhu, Shengma (Cimicifuga, 升麻), Zaoren, Bixie, Xianglian.

Pill formula: remove Bixie; add Wuwei, Jinyingzi, and Ejiao; pound into pills.

Mistakenly taking medicated wine, heat pours into the bladder, with turbid discharge in the urine, prolonged without recovery, vexation and thirst with wasting of the flesh. Examining the six pulses, they are not wiry and rapid. Here use the Buzhong Yiqi (補中益氣) method with additions and subtractions.

Xi Dangshen, Shudi, Maidong, Bixie, Shengma, Lugen, Zhi Yuzhu, Fushen, Wuwei, Muli, Xianglian.

Turbid discharge with lumbar pain, the governing vessel (督脈) injured — treat by securing the essence and supplementing qi.

Da Shudi, Jinyingzi, Chuanduan, Longgu (dragon bone, 龍骨), Jing Guishen, Qianshi (Euryale, 芡實), Gouji, Duzhong.

Prolonged turbid discharge without stopping, with pain and flaccidity of the kidney region — treat by separating the clear and warming and moistening.

Xi Dangshen, Chuan Bixie, Dan Congrong, Duzhong, sheng Guishen, Da Shudi, Chi Fuling, Sha Jili, Muli, Xianglian rou.

Blood in the urine together with turbid discharge, frequent urination with pain, the left hypochondrium not harmonious — I fear there may be accumulated blood; this formula is for temporary use.

Chuanlian, Bixie, Walengzi, Gancao, Guixu, Chiling, Yuanhusuo.

Turbid discharge lingering for a long time — damp fire descending. Treat by raising the clear and separating and draining.

Yuan Shengdi, Chuan Bixie, Zhi Shengma, Chiling, Lianxu, Danpi, Gancao shao, sheng Miren, Zexie.
translator_notes: 四君 (si jun) refers to the Sijunzi Tang (Four Gentlemen Decoction); kept as 'Sijun'.
補中益氣 (Buzhong Yiqi) is a formula name; kept as 'Buzhong Yiqi'.

translation:
Distension of the diaphragm with blood in the urine, arising from depression of the qi of the Jueyin (厥陰) and injury to the bladder collaterals. Temporarily use a method of breaking stasis and guiding downward.

Chuanlian, Zhi Jun (processed rhubarb, 制軍), Chuan Yujin, Zexie, Gancao shao, Chiling, Guixu, Yanhusuo, Loupi, Hupo xie (amber powder, 琥珀屑).

Follow-up formula:

Bixie, Dan Ling (Poria, 淡苓), Niuxi tan, Zexie, sheng Ou (raw lotus root, 生藕), Chiling, Danpi, sheng Miren, Lianxu.

Abdominal distension with urination and defecation, blood in the urine descending — arising from heat depression of the liver channel and injury to the bladder collaterals. First one should disperse stagnation, then cultivate and supplement to obtain effect. (female)

Chuan Huanglian, Danggui xu, Chishao (red peony, 赤芍), Cheqian, Zhiqiao (bitter orange, 枳殼), Zhi Shengjun (processed rhubarb, 制生軍), Niuxi tan, Chiling, Zexie, Xinjiang xie.

Follow-up formula:

Sheng Yuzhu, Hupo xie, Chiling, Zexie, Hedai, sheng Miren, Chuan Yujin, Bixie, sheng Cao (raw licorice, 生草).

Damp-heat injuring the collaterals, previously there was blood in the urine, the complexion and spirit sallow and yellow. One should use a method of strengthening the middle and separating and regulating (aged six or seven years, little food and drink, pain when urinating; treating a child of six or seven years with blood in the urine and bitter pain, the primordial vigorous, administered Chuanlian and Dahuang).

Sheng Yuzhu, Chiling, Zexie, Mudanpi, Dongguazi, sheng Miren, Bixie, Chuan Bai, sheng Gancao.

Blood in the urine together with turbid discharge, frequent urination with pain, the left hypochondrium not harmonious. I fear there may be accumulated blood; this formula is for temporary use.

Chuanlian, Bixie, Walengzi, Gancao, Guixu, Chiling, Yuanhusuo.

The heart fire presses internally, the bladder collaterals are injured, so that there is blood in the urine.

Sheng Yangshen, Yuan Shengdi, Danshen, Xueyu hui (charred hair, 血餘灰), Bixie, Da Maidong, Mudanpi, Fushen, Hupo xie.

Blood in the urine with pain on urination, prolonged without recovery, the six pulses without strength. One must attend to both the root and the branch.

Xi Dangshen, stir-fried Danpi, Bixie, stir-fried Ejiao, Hu Ou, Yun Fuling, stir-fried Qizi, Shengma, Gancao shao.

Blood in the urine lingering for a long time, with pain in the lumbar region and abdomen; repeatedly administering draining agents, the qi sinks and injures the fluids, so that the spirit is weary and the six pulses fine and soft. If one does not raise the clear and cultivate and supplement, I fear the illness will be severe at the turn of autumn.

Xi Dangshen, Chi Fushen, Shengma, Shayuan, Muxiang, Zhi Yuzhu, Gancao shao, Qizi, Bixie, Oujie.
